title: Senior SFDC Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior SFDC Developer
Location: Remote
Terms: Long Term Contract



Key "Must-Have” Skills:
  • Salesforce Development (6+ years)
  • Salesforce CPQ (2+ years)
  • Apex
  • Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • REST API

"Nice-to-Have” Skills:
  • Salesforce Billing
  • Salesforce certifications (e.g., Platform Developer II, CPQ Specialist)

Ideal Candidate Profile: An experienced and highly skilled Senior Salesforce Developer with a strong background in Sales Cloud, Apex, LWC, REST APIs, and JavaScript. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Salesforce CPQ and is able to design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions.

Summary of Job Description:
This role involves designing, developing, and maintaining scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, LWC, and other Salesforce technologies. The candidate will implement and customize Salesforce CPQ and Billing solutions, integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST APIs, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions.


Job Responsibilities:
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, LWC, and other Salesforce technologies.
  • Implement and customize Salesforce CPQ and Billing solutions.
  • Integrate Salesforce with external systems using REST APIs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Ensure best practices in coding, testing, and deployment.
